data.description:
**Relive the fantasy chess, now in VR!**

Do you remember playing Battle Chess in your old microcomputer at home? Now you can bring back those feelings with in an immersive VR environment and a set of living pieces with carefully crafted animations.

{2199663147059307}

But you can find more environemts to match your mood! The Escher Dream submerges you in a dreamlike world with impossible spaces. If you want to relax in scenarios more tied to reality, you can also enjoy the calm and tranquility of Grand Palace and Masters Garden

Challenge your friends, face off against our AI, or compete against other Chess enthusiasts worldwide.

Play using hand-tracking or controllers, and show off your best moves as you build up your ELO!

With Chess Club and the magic of Mixed Reality, you can enjoy the game in any real-world setting and invite your friends to join the fun!

 
# Key features
♘ Play against a friend or the AI

✌️ Hand-tracking and controllers support. Choose the way you play!

🏆 Casual and ranked matches

⛰️ 4 Environments: Grand Palace, Stonehenge, Escher Dream and Masters Garden

♟️  Choose your style: from old school chessboard to fantasy style, animated pieces 

🙂 Avatars and Voice IP to play with your friends

⚔️ Rematch System

📜 Track your moves history

⏲️ Select your favorite time rules

 {7698461016875798}

Join our Discord community to participate in tournaments and connect with more players (https://discord.gg/oddersgames)

changelog.change_log:
**UPDATE CHESS CLUB 2.0.2 - MIXED REALITY - Aug 2024**

We are happy to share we have been polishing the MR experience of Chess Club for our amazing community!

- **Chessboard Fix:** Resolved the issue where the chessboard would disappear when switching rooms
- **Matchmaking Visuals:** Squashed some pesky visual bugs during matchmaking.
- **Gameplay Stability:** Improved stability when transitioning between environments.
- **Masters Garden:** Enhanced rendering for a more immersive experience.
- **Menu Fixes:** Addressed errors with avatars and features like mute and hide.
- **Grab Handles:** Smoother and more responsive grab handle functionality.

Enjoy!

**CHESS CLUB 2.0.10 - MIXED REALITY - Jul 2024**

**The greatest strategy game of all time is now available in Mixed Reality!**

- Choose from 4 breathtaking environments and bring the chess board into your own room with Mixed Reality update
- Mixed Reality is available in all game modes. Against AI, ranked matches, online with your friends… You can enjoy MR even in the main menu!
- Pick up the die and switch between VR and MR at any time.
- Tons of bug fixes & improvements. Always working hard to provide you with the best possible Chess Club experience.

Enjoy!

CHESS CLUB 1.8.13 - TIME TO REMATCH + VOICE FIX - Jun 2023
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

• Rematch: when finishing a multiplayer game, just press on “Rematch” and wait for the opponent to accept! This was highly requested, and here it is!
• Improved the AI difficulty balancing
• We fixed the Voice Activation feature
• Added visual cues when you are transmiting voice.
• Now you can also mute yourself
• New and better hands model when using Hand-Tracking
• Claiming a deserted game is now possible after just 30 minutes
• New pop-up window when your opponent deserts in a ranked game for you to claim it after 30 mins
• Multiplayer stability improvements
• Voice chat error during multiplayer mode was fixed!!
• Some minor visual bug fixing
  • Visual overlapping removed
  • Text corrections & Labels
  • Render priorities
• Some more fixes & improvements, as usual

CHESS CLUB 1.8.11 - TIME TO REMATCH - May 2023
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

• Rematch: when finishing a multiplayer game, just press on “Rematch” and wait for the opponent to accept! This was highly requested, and here it is!
• Improved the AI difficulty balancing
• We fixed the Voice Activation feature
• Added visual cues when you are transmiting voice.
• Now you can also mute yourself
• New and better hands model when using Hand-Tracking
• Claiming a deserted game is now possible after just 30 minutes
• New pop-up window when your opponent deserts in a ranked game for you to claim it after 30 mins
• Multiplayer stability improvements
• Some minor visual bug fixing
  • Visual overlapping removed
  • Text corrections & Labels
  • Render priorities
• Some more fixes & improvements, as usual

KNOWN ISSUES: Due to some changes in the mic permissions functionality in the latest firmware versions of Meta, we are aware of a random error occurring in the voice chat during multiplayer mode, which causes users to have no access to voice. We are working to fix the issue and will release a patch ASAP

CHESS CLUB 1.6.09 - PARTY CHAT PATCH UPDATE - March 2023
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Fixed THE "black screen of death" error when the players starts a multiplayer game while using Meta Party Chat.

Really, tracking down this error has driven us crazy. Many thanks again to our amazing community for help us to improve the game!!! Enjoy!!! 🥰🥰🥰

CHESS CLUB 1.6.08 - MULTIPLAYER PATCH UPDATE - Feb 2023
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Multiplayer mode is now much more stable: a full review of the multiplayer protocol was performed and the errors are now gone. 
• Fixed some textures on Grand Hotel
• Bug fixes

Many thanks to our amazing community for help us to improve the game!!! 🥰🥰🥰

CHESS CLUB 1.6.07 - PARK & CLOCKS UPDATE - PATCH 4 - January 2022
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• A functional chess clock in every environment. It will match the style of each scenario, it looks cool and feels even better!
• A new natural environment: a peaceful park with lots of light and greens
• Enhanced Voice Activacion Commands (give them a try!)
• Credits added to the game, grab the block to see who did what!
• Some improvements:
    • Profile image
    • Better Draw & Claim winning behaviour
    • Environment preview icons on the UI
• Very minor bug fixes
• PATCH 1 - Fixed the board coordinates of new environment
• PATCH 2 - Fixed a blocking error when the player do not allowed the audio permission
• PATCH 3 - Fixed some Autoclock bug fixes
• PATCH 4 - Fixed some text issues

CHESS CLUB 1.6.06 - PARK & CLOCKS UPDATE - December 2022
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• A functional chess clock in every environment. It will match the style of each scenario, it looks cool and feels even better!
• A new natural environment: a peaceful park with lots of light and greens
• Enhanced Voice Activacion Commands (give them a try!)

• Some improvements:
    • Profile image
    • Better Draw & Claim winning behaviour
    • Environment preview icons on the UI
• Fixed a blocking error when the player do not allowed the audio permission
• Very minor bug fixes


CHESS CLUB 1.6.06 - PARK & CLOCKS UPDATE - Diciembre 2022
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Un reloj de ajedrez funcional en cada entorno. Va a juego con el estilo de cada entorno, ¡luce muy bien y se siente aún mejor!
• Un nuevo entorno natural: un pacífico parque con mucha luz y vegetación
• Comandos de Activación de Voz Mejorados (¡pruébalos!)
• Créditos añadidos al juego, ¡agarra la pieza para ver quién hizo qué!
• Algunas mejoras:
    • Imagen de perfil
    • Mejora del comportamiento de empate y reclamación de partida
    • Iconos de previsualización de la IU
• Pequeños bugs arreglados


CHESS CLUB 1.6.06 – PARK- UND UHREN-UPDATE – Dezember 2022
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Eine funktionale Schachuhr in jeder Umgebung. Sie passt zum Stil eines jeden Szenarios, sieht fantastisch aus und ist noch besser zu benutzen!
• Neue natürliche Umgebung: ein friedlicher Park mit viel Licht und Grün
• Verbesserte Sprachsteuerungsbefehle (probieren Sie es aus!)
• Credits wurden hinzugefügt: Sehen Sie sich an, wer welche Bereiche geschaffen hat!
• Zahlreiche Verbesserungen:
    • Profilbild
    • Besseres Gewinnverhalten bei Unentschieden und Sieg
    • Umgebungsvorschau-Symbole in der Benutzeroberfläche
• Kleinere Fehlerbehebungen


CHESS CLUB (CLUB D'ÉCHECS) 1.6.06 - MISE À JOUR DU PARC ET DES PENDULES - Décembre 2022
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Une pendule d'échecs fonctionnelle dans tous les environnements. Assortie au style de chaque scénario, elle a l'air encore plus cool !
• Un nouvel environnement naturel : Un parc paisible avec beaucoup de lumière et de verdure.
• Commandes d'activation vocale améliorées (Essayez-les !).
• Crédits ajoutés au jeu, consultez le tableau pour voir qui a fait quoi !
• Autres améliorations :
    • Image de profil,
    • Meilleur comportement des parties nulles et des abandons en position gagnante,
    • Icônes d'aperçu de l'environnement sur l'interface utilisateur.
• Correction de bug mineurs.


CHESS CLUB 1.6.06 - PARK & CLOCKSアップデート：2022年11月
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• あらゆる環境に対応する機能的なチェスクロック。各シナリオのスタイルに合い、見た目もカッコよく使い心地も最高です！
• 新しい自然環境：光と緑にあふれた穏やかな公園
• 進化したボイスアクティベーションコマンド（ぜひお試しください！）
• ゲームにクレジットを追加。ブロックをつかんで、スタッフとその役割を確認しましょう！
• いくつかの改良点：
    • プロフィール画像
    • 抽選とクレーム獲得アクションの改良
    • UIに環境プレビューのアイコンを表示
• 非常に細かいバグ修正


체스 클럽 1.6.06 - 공원 및 시계 업데이트 - 2022년 11월
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• 모든 환경에서 기능적인 체스 시계. 각 시나리오의 스타일과 잘 어울릴 정도로 외관이 한층 더 멋지고 세련되어졌습니다!
• 새로운 자연환경: 햇살이 가득하고 녹지가 풍부한 평화로운 공원
• 향상된 음성 액티베이션 명령(사용해 보세요!)
• 게임에 크레딧이 추가되었습니다. 블록을 잡고 누가 무엇을 했는지 확인하세요!
• 몇 가지 개선 사항:
    • 프로필 이미지
    • 더 나은 무승부 및 승리 쟁취 행동
    • UI의 환경 미리보기 아이콘
• 사소한 버그 수정


国际象棋俱乐部1.6.06 - 公园和时钟更新- 2022年11月
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• 适用于各种环境的象棋时钟。时钟可与每个场景风格相匹配，外观炫酷，体验更好！
• 全新自然环境：阳光明媚、绿意盎然的宁静公园
• 增强型语音激活指令（试试看！）
• 积分已添加到游戏中，抓住方块，看看谁干了什么！
• 一些改进：
    • 个人资料头像
    • 更好的抽奖和领奖获胜行为
    • 用户界面上的环境预览图标
• 极小的错误修复

• あらゆる環境に対応する機能的なチェスクロック。各シナリオのスタイルに合い、見た目もカッコよく使い心地も最高です！
• 新しい自然環境：光と緑にあふれた穏やかな公園
• 進化したボイスアクティベーションコマンド（ぜひお試しください！）
• ゲームにクレジットを追加。ブロックをつかんで、スタッフとその役割を確認しましょう！
• いくつかの改良点：

    • 抽選とクレーム獲得アクションの改良
    • UIに環境プレビューのアイコンを表示
• 非常に細かいバグ修正

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• 모든 환경에서 기능적인 체스 시계. 각 시나리오의 스타일과 잘 어울릴 정도로 외관이 한층 더 멋지고 세련되어졌습니다!
• 새로운 자연환경: 햇살이 가득하고 녹지가 풍부한 평화로운 공원
• 향상된 음성 액티베이션 명령(사용해 보세요!)
• 게임에 크레딧이 추가되었습니다. 블록을 잡고 누가 무엇을 했는지 확인하세요!
• 몇 가지 개선 사항:
    • 프로필 이미지
    • 더 나은 무승부 및 승리 쟁취 행동
    • UI의 환경 미리보기 아이콘
• 사소한 버그 수정

CHESS CLUB 1.5.04 - AVATARS & VOICE UPDATE - September 2022
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Meta Avatars 2.0: The latest version of Meta Avatars is now available in Chess Club!
• New Set of Avatars: a set of pre-set avatar with face expressions that will put yourself in the shoes of the likes of a physics genius or a red-haired chess master.
• Voice Commands: navigate through menus, find a match and move your pieces just using voice commands!
• Death Dance: make the cemetery pieces dance by saying "Death Dance". Or don't, your choice.
• Bug fixes, of course

CHESS CLUB 1.4.27 - HANDS-ON EMOTION UPDATE - May 2022
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• You can now send emotions to your opponent: ok, like, dislike, love, it rocks! cool, hurry up & victory!
• You can use hand-tracking gestures or the game panel to send these emotions
• You can also play with the cemetery pieces freely: throw the pieces, play with them on the table, balance them on your hands, roll those pieces, and more!
• Some more fixes & improvements, as usual

CHESS CLUB 1.4.02 - HANDS-ON UPDATE - FEATURING HANDS 2.0 - April 2022
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• The game is now compatible with the brand new Hands 2.0 feature released with V39 Quest software, which provides much better hand tracking.
• Some bugs fixed

CHESS CLUB 1.4.00 - HANDS-ON UPDATE - April 2022
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Improved Hand-Tracking system for a fully natural grip of the pieces
• It's now possible to pass one piece from one hand to the other, try it!
• Hands visuals have been enhanced
• Hands now have the real size of the player's hand when using Hand-Tracking mode
• You can now use gestures to:
  ◦  Mute / Unmute music
  ◦  Mute / Unmute opponent
  ◦  Hide / Show opponent
• Multiplayer mode is now more stable
  ◦ A full revamp of the protocol was performed
  ◦ We've reinforce the behavior of the system when one of the players loses connection to the Internet or has an inestable network
  ◦ We've added a reconnect screen when someone is taken out of the match due to any error
• We've added some nice details as well:
  ◦ Now you can see two extra columns: "Claimable" and "Scoring"
  ◦ Added the "Scoring" column to the History panel
  ◦ Notifications now have sound alerts
  ◦ Visual improvements in the main menu
  ◦ Enhanced Matchmaking effect
  ◦ Improvements on the menu buttons
• Various fixes & improvements

Chess Club 1.3.00 - Social & Language Update
----------------------------------------------------
• Added more ways to invite & join friends in matches from the Oculus app & store!
• Language support added for spanish, french, german, japanese and korean.
• We keep fine tuning all the processes, so no bugs around!

Chess Club 1.2.20 - Matchmaking patch
----------------------------------------------------
• Auto-match mechanism improved: now you can set "any" in your game preferences for a more flexible matchmaking.
• Polished some bugs here and there.

Chess 1.2.04 - Escher Dream Update
-------------------------------------------
• New environment: “Escher Dream”
• New "Automatch" feature for a better matchmaking experience
• Addes some nice options during gameplay:
    • Mute music
    • Mute your opponent (audio and/or avatar)
    • Speed up Stonehenge animations
• New feature to "Claim match" when the opponent abandoned the match for over 48h
• Other good stuff:
    • On rated matches, side selection is randomized
    • Minor visual upgrades in some menus such as the list of matches or whether a match is claimable or not
• Gently polished some bugs here and there
